heroHeadline: Hormuz Shipping Hits Six-Month High as Over 1 Billion Barrels Transit Under US Naval Posture
heroSubtitle: US military data shows strait throughput reaching its highest level in six months, a sign of partial supply-chain recovery even as the East-West pipeline remains shut and Yanbu loadings suspended
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports (FAO, World Bank, IMF, IEA, WFP), major outlets (Reuters, Bloomberg, Al Jazeera, CNBC), and institutional analyses (Lloyd's List, S&P Global, IFPRI, Atlantic Council).
